apps/web/components/features/admin/feedb.loading: The table receives items the admin page already loaded on the server and renders no loading face of its own.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.empty: The shell is the loading face of the Audience table and owns no collection that could be empty.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.long-content: The shell takes no props and draws fixed skeleton bars, so there is no caller text that could grow.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The shell never fetches or mutates and takes no props; the real offline handling lives in the table that replaces it.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.loading: The table receives rows its page already loaded; the loading face is AudienceTableLoadingShell, which has its own states story.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The table has no error view: a failed member removal or copy only raises toast.error in the app-wide toaster, outside the table surface.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The table has no offline view: its fetch calls (remove member, source link) report failures through toast.error, outside the table surface.
